[[File:Harm Accelerator New.png|right]]The '''Harm Accelerator''' is an Attack Mod that Bleeds the opponent for an entire minute.

==Description==
''A module that doesn't fool around. Drop this mod on a node and watch your opponent take a trip to destination pain.''

==Max Stats==

==Abilities==

=== Basic Abilities ===
* [[Bleed]]

=== Abilities ===
* ''Special Attacks:'' Add an additional stack of Bleed.
* ''Passive:'' 100% chance to Bleed, dealing 480~924% Attack over 60 seconds.

==Strategy==

=== Defense ===
A preferred pairing used by many Commanders is with defenders with high health, notably [[Grindor]]s and [[Motormaster]]s. If the Mod's signature ability is unlocked, using it with Bots that deal damage debuffs often is recommended. 

Another strategy is to give players an ultimatum. For example, pairing a Tech class with a Harm Accelerator brings players to choose between type advantages or potentially losing a bot early on. A good example is a duplicated [[Wheeljack]] with his near impenetrable force shields.

* [[Bonecrusher]]
* Bludgeon
* Drift
* Rhinox
* Windblade
* Pretty much [[Bleed|everyone who can Bleed]]

=== Raids ===
A basic rule of thumb to follow if you're facing a Bot on one of these: '''NEVER GET TAGGED BY A SPECIAL ATTACK.''' More stacks of Bleed won't and will ''not'' be pleasant.

* [[Optimus Primal]] - With [[Optimus Primal]] and two other Beast Wars bots, the Beast Purification Synergy will let bots other than Brawlers purify the Bleed with heavy attacks
* [[Grimlock]] -  with his Purify signature ability. He'll quickly neutralize the Bleed debuff that would normally eat away significant amounts of health. More melee buffs to crush your enemies!
* [[Optimus Prime (MV1)]] - Willpower will recover some of his health bleeding out while attacking.
* [[Thundercracker]] can purify normal Bleeds and Harm Accelerators using Heavy Attacks.
* [[Tantrum]] - No holding back. It's best to keep charging into the opponent to build frenzies and melee buffs. No more bleeding the bull.
